mainEntity.name: Can customer query research for GEO identify new market opportunities?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, customer query research for GEO can identify untapped market opportunities. By analyzing search demand in unserved or underserved areas, businesses can discover new locations where their services or products are sought after but competition is low. This insight enables strategic expansion and targeted marketing efforts in regions with proven demand, maximizing return on investment for growth initiatives.
